own_solution.law: The de Broglie relation and non-relativistic kinetic energy give lambda = hc/sqrt(2(mc²)K). Converting mc² to 511000 eV gives lambda = 1240/sqrt(2 × 511000 × 54) nm = 166.9165 pm. An additional energy q imparted to this electron replaces K by 54 eV + q.
assumptions: The electron starts from rest, as stated.
The explicitly prescribed non-relativistic model applies.
All energies are converted to compatible units before numerical substitution.

notes: All certified answers agree with the governing relations after converting energies to common units and wavelengths to the specified target unit, pm. For either relevant sentence, q = 50, 100 and 200 eV gives approximately 120.276, 98.8407 and 76.9625 pm, respectively. The disconnected sentences leave the answer unchanged at every listed value. The maximum final electron energy is 254 eV, well below its 511000 eV rest energy and within the claimed upper bound of 500 eV. Both declared minimal pairs preserve the number and unit and change the energy recipient and its associated apparatus as intended. There is no substantive disagreement with pass 1; its answers were expressed in nm.
